pr.title: Say that the panel names repositories in lowercase
pr.head: 53746d4de07eb77203b8736a4398107ed13b9adc

summary: Projector's panel is the list above the Claude Code prompt that shows each pull request a session fixes or reviews, one line each. Each line starts with the pull request's number, which the panel labels by how many repositories it lists. Since the change merged as #481, the panel lowercases every repository name as it reads the files that track pull requests. GitHub ignores the case of owner and repository names, so one repository now has one spelling throughout the panel.

That change made the panel show acme/app#12 for a pull request you subscribed to as Acme/App#12, which a reader could take for a bug. This pull request changes only docs/plugins.md. It says how a row's number is labeled, that the pull request lines show repositories in lowercase and why, and that the reference Discuss puts in the prompt is lowercase too. It also says that an inbox item about a pull request the panel does not list names it as the agent wrote it, capitals included. It changes no code.

groups.title: How the panel names a pull request
groups.kicker: The panel guide's description of a row's number, the Discuss reference, and an inbox item's pull request
intro: The panel labels a row's number with labeler in hooks/register.tsx, and builds the reference that Discuss inserts with referencer. Both read repo from the pull requests that the three parsers in hooks/parse.ts return, and each parser lowercases it.

• One repository. Every row reads #267, and Discuss inserts #267.
  • Several repositories with distinct names. Rows read app#267, and Discuss inserts the full acme/app#267.
  • Two repositories that share a name. Every row reads its full owner/repo#267, not only the two that share the name.

files.note: The paragraph on a row's number gains the labeling rule and the lowercase rule, the Discuss bullet says its reference is lowercase, and the inbox paragraph says how an item names a pull request the panel does not list.

checks.text: Each label in the new text matches labeler and referencer at this head, including every row's switch to the full owner/repo once two repositories share a name. The reviewer traced the lowercase spelling to parseTracked, parseSubscriptions, and parseAdopted, and checked that the rewrapped paragraph keeps to the width of the lines around it.

pullOf in hooks/register.tsx labels an item's pull request as its row does when the panel lists it, and otherwise shows the item's pr unchanged. project inbox stores pr as the agent gave it, so Acme/App#12 keeps its capitals.
